properties.name: Guarded I-5 Corridor
properties.known_for: Protected commerce among Everett, Seattle, and Tacoma
properties.access: Checkpoints, convoy schedules, and locally controlled approaches
properties.description: The surviving I-5 corridor carries guarded commerce through the Puget Sound city-states. Control changes along the route, and Tacoma maintains a defensive zone without routinely stopping through traffic.

properties.name: West Seattle Ferry Route
properties.known_for: Connecting West Seattle with the central waterfront
properties.access: Scheduled sailings and neighborhood-controlled terminals
properties.description: Ferries supplement West Seattle's surviving guarded bridges and carry passengers and light cargo to the central city.

properties.name: Space Needle
properties.known_for: Observation decks, civic ceremonies, and skyline visibility
properties.access: Public lower levels; controlled upper access
properties.description: Seattle's most recognizable surviving landmark remains a civic symbol, observation point, and carefully maintained piece of the pre-Razz skyline.

properties.name: Helios Campus
properties.known_for: Biomedical research and its elevated central platform
properties.access: Public perimeter; credentialed interior
properties.description: Five research buildings and an elevated central platform dominate Seattle's biomedical corridor. Corporate security treats the campus as critical infrastructure.

properties.name: Boeing Field Fortress
properties.known_for: Heavy security, air operations, and industrial capacity
properties.access: Restricted perimeter inside Bombshell
properties.description: The surviving Boeing Field complex has become a hardened corporate-industrial fortress surrounded by the damaged infrastructure of southern Seattle.

properties.name: The Names We Carry
properties.known_for: The Unforgotten and Unforgiven observance and metahuman civil-rights vigils
properties.access: Public plaza during daylight and commemorations
properties.description: A destroyed armored carrier has become Bombshell's public memorial to metahumans killed during one of Seattle's defining acts of violence. The annual Unforgotten and Unforgiven observance keeps the site politically and culturally active.
properties.events: Unforgotten and Unforgiven is the annual memorial observance.

properties.name: Meridian–Silicon Wilds Ferry Route
properties.known_for: Soundline passenger service, Crosswake freight, Lucky Crossing casino service, expeditions, and salvage
properties.access: Madison and Leschi terminals with controlled Eastside landings
properties.organizations: Soundline Co-op, Crosswake Marine, and Lucky Crossing
properties.connections: Meridian to Eastside settlements; returning salvage continues to Gasworks or corporate buyers
properties.description: Lake Washington ferries connect Meridian with the Silicon Wilds. Expeditions, traders, and outfitters travel east; recovered technology returns through Madison or Leschi toward Gasworks workshops and corporate buyers.

properties.name: The Seam
properties.known_for: Salvage, information, expedition gear, and twenty-four-hour trade
properties.access: Beneath and alongside I-5 in Meridian
properties.description: The Seam is Meridian's twenty-four-hour market under I-5, where brokers, fixers, traders, and expedition crews exchange equipment, salvage, information, and introductions.

properties.name: Madison Ferry Terminal
properties.known_for: Soundline service and Eastside expedition departures
properties.access: Ticketed public service with cargo and identity checks
properties.description: Madison is Meridian's principal passenger and light-cargo terminal for Lake Washington crossings.

properties.name: Leschi Freight Terminal
properties.known_for: Vehicles, salvage shipments, and expedition cargo
properties.access: Controlled freight yards and scheduled vehicle ferries
properties.description: Leschi handles heavy freight, vehicles, and the bulk of the salvage returning from the Silicon Wilds.

properties.name: Afterimage
properties.known_for: Music, runners, brokers, and dangerous private business
properties.access: Public club floor; selective private rooms
properties.description: Afterimage is one of Meridian's best-known nightlife and deal-making venues. It is emphatically not neutral ground.

properties.name: The Third Door
properties.known_for: Introductions, arbitration, and protected negotiations
properties.access: Admission by established standing and invitation
properties.governance: The Three Elders enforce venue neutrality
properties.description: The Third Door is a tightly controlled neutral venue for experienced runners, fixers, and brokers. Violence or coercion inside carries consequences across Meridian.
properties.gm_notes: The Three Elders are Etta 'Switch' Mercer, Garran 'Rampart' Okoye, and Ilyra 'Copper' Venn. Exact admission mechanics remain unresolved.

properties.name: The Foundry
properties.known_for: Fabrication bays, prototyping, induction, and workshop collaboration
properties.access: Members receive priority; visitors require sponsorship or a public event
properties.description: The Foundry is Gasworks' central shared makerspace and industrial complex, providing equipment and work areas that small shops could not maintain alone.
properties.events: AQRE/The Works is the annual exposition and induction festival.

properties.name: Gas Works Park
properties.known_for: Old machinery, gatherings, and views across the canal
properties.access: Open grounds with locally posted restrictions
properties.description: The preserved industrial structures of Gas Works Park remain a district landmark and gathering place.
properties.gm_notes: Subsurface structures and inhabitants are unresolved rumors, not established canon.

properties.name: Fremont Lenin Statue
properties.known_for: Gasworks' inherited eccentric civic identity
properties.access: Open street access
properties.description: The old Lenin statue survives as a familiar meeting point and symbol of the district's cultivated weirdness.

properties.name: Physics-Astronomy Prometheus Shard
properties.known_for: One of the university's two expended Prometheus Shards
properties.access: Public lobby during campus hours
properties.description: An expended Prometheus Shard is displayed in the Physics-Astronomy lobby under university security.

properties.name: Allen Center Prometheus Shard
properties.known_for: One of the university's two expended Prometheus Shards
properties.access: Public lobby during campus hours
properties.description: An expended Prometheus Shard is displayed in the Allen Center lobby under university and corporate observation.

properties.name: Bombshell Mutual Works
properties.known_for: Repairs, supplies, neighborhood coordination, and practical relief
properties.access: Open to residents and volunteers subject to local safety rules
properties.description: Auntie Lee Varga's mutual-aid network coordinates repairs, supplies, and neighborhood rebuilding across Bombshell.

properties.name: Church of the Shattered Glass
properties.known_for: Mutual support, apocalyptic preaching, and Sister Rhea Calder
properties.access: Open services; congregation-controlled private areas
properties.description: The Church of the Shattered Glass is an active Bombshell congregation led by Sister Rhea Calder, offering community support alongside uncompromising spiritual teaching.
properties.gm_notes: Rhea sincerely worships Abraxas; this is not merely a grift or cover identity.

properties.name: West Seattle High Bridge
properties.known_for: Primary bridge access to West Seattle
properties.access: Identity, cargo, and weapons checks
properties.description: The surviving high bridge remains one of West Seattle's principal overland connections and is guarded by Civic Guard checkpoints.

properties.name: 1st Avenue South Bridge
properties.known_for: Southern vehicle and freight access to West Seattle
properties.access: Identity, cargo, and weapons checks
properties.description: The 1st Avenue South Bridge provides West Seattle's surviving southern overland connection and is guarded as critical infrastructure.

properties.name: Washington Park Arboretum Wild
properties.known_for: Dense altered plant life and unreliable interior paths
properties.access: Travel with local guides and protective equipment
properties.description: The Arboretum has become a true urban Wild. Its altered vegetation and shifting safe paths form a hazardous eastern edge within Meridian.
properties.gm_notes: Specific rumored inhabitants or phenomena remain unconfirmed and should not be presented as settled canon.

properties.name: Madrona Decay Wild
properties.known_for: Unstable structures, altered growth, and unreliable streets
properties.access: Marked perimeter routes only
properties.description: Parts of Madrona have collapsed into an urban decay Wild whose damaged streets and altered growth complicate Meridian's lakefront routes.
properties.gm_notes: Specific rumored inhabitants or phenomena remain unconfirmed and should not be presented as settled canon.

properties.name: AQRE / The Works
properties.known_for: Public demonstrations, new makers, prototypes, and Gasworks-wide celebration
properties.access: Public exhibitions with member-only workshop events
properties.description: The Works is Gasworks' annual exposition, festival, and induction season, when workshops demonstrate new projects and prospective members enter the district's maker culture.

properties.name: Eriador, Inc.
properties.known_for: Small-scale technical work within the workshop economy
properties.access: Business access by appointment
properties.description: Eriador, Inc. operates inside Gasworks' larger workshop ecosystem and employs Stella Brownlock.

properties.name: Kirkland Downs
properties.status: Independent fishing, agricultural, and salvage enclave
properties.known_for: Earthquake ruins, lake trade, local farming, and salvage
properties.access: Lake landings and the I-405 corridor
properties.description: Kirkland Downs occupies surviving lakefront and earthquake ruins, balancing fishing, agriculture, and salvage under a local mayor and council.

properties.name: Badvue
properties.known_for: Casinos, outfitting, vice, and fast frontier money
properties.access: Ferries, I-405, and guarded local approaches
properties.governance: A compact among the dominant houses
properties.organizations: Lucky Crossing and Badvue's house compact
properties.description: Former downtown Bellevue has become Badvue, a casino boomtown where expedition outfitting, vice, salvage money, and house politics meet.

properties.name: Mercer Island Outpost
properties.known_for: Food production, lake trade, and operational ties to the Silicon Wilds
properties.access: Lake crossings and locally controlled roads
properties.description: Mercer Island lies outside the Silicon Wilds' strict east-of-lake geography but is culturally and operationally part of its settlement network.

properties.name: Forgetown
properties.known_for: Scaling rough prototypes into practical mass production
properties.access: I-405 freight traffic and controlled gates
properties.connections: Gasworks prototypes commonly move here for larger production runs
properties.description: Built around former Factoria, Forgetown manufactures whatever the frontier can pay for and turns Gasworks prototypes into rugged production goods.

properties.name: Fool's End
properties.known_for: Tolls, hardened defenses, and control of the Redmond approach
properties.access: SR-520 corridor under local inspection and toll
properties.description: Redmond's surviving settlement, commonly called Fool's End, is a fortified military fief controlling a major route into the eastern Wilds.

properties.name: I-405 Wilds Corridor
properties.known_for: Trade among Kirkland Downs, Badvue, and Forgetown
properties.access: Convoys, settlement patrols, and negotiated tolls
properties.description: Surviving stretches of I-405 form the Wilds' main north-south trade spine among Kirkland Downs, Badvue, and Forgetown.

properties.name: SR-520 Wilds Corridor
properties.known_for: Access from Lake Washington toward Fool's End
properties.access: Patrolled segments, tolls, and hazardous gaps
properties.description: The surviving SR-520 corridor connects Eastside lake approaches with Fool's End and the routes beyond Redmond.

properties.name: Port of Tacoma
properties.known_for: International cargo, military logistics, and Black Helix-secured convoys
properties.access: Ephorate-controlled harbor and credentialed freight zones
properties.description: Tacoma's deepwater port is the foundation of its independence and a trade asset Seattle cannot afford to lose.

properties.name: Porter Way Memorial
properties.known_for: Remembering the school-bus victims of the Porter Way Bombing
properties.access: Public roadside memorial near Milton
properties.description: The memorial marks the Porter Way Bombing, where a Human Coalition Front attack intended for a convoy struck a school bus thirteen years before the campaign.
properties.gm_notes: The current status of Human Coalition Front remnants and ties to militant Empty Seats activity are campaign material.

properties.name: Tacoma Defensive Zone
properties.known_for: Checkpoints between Fife and the I-5/Highway 161 interchange
properties.access: Through traffic usually continues; entry into Tacoma-controlled territory is inspected
properties.description: Tacoma's northern defensive zone protects the approaches near Fife and Milton without routinely interfering with I-5 traffic passing through the corridor.

properties.name: Alder House
properties.status: Old City shelter in a converted former hotel
properties.known_for: Seattle’s largest and best-known local homeless shelter
properties.access: Public intake and community services; overnight capacity managed by staff
properties.description: Alder House occupies a former hotel in Old City and has grown into the district’s largest and best-known homeless shelter. Longtime director and caretaker Margaret “Mags” Okafor is a familiar neighborhood figure whose authority comes from decades of keeping the doors open.
properties.connections: Old City service networks, churches, neighborhood merchants, outreach workers, and municipal social-service contacts

properties.name: The Stadium
properties.status: Continuously modernized stadium and event complex
properties.known_for: Sports, major public events, corporate hospitality, and crowds from across Seattle
properties.access: Public event access with variable security and credentialing
properties.description: The Stadium is a large, continuously updated complex south of downtown. Its corporate naming rights change often enough that locals simply call it the Stadium, treating the shifting sponsor identity as background noise.
properties.connections: Old City, Corporate Core transit, waterfront routes, event security, food and service businesses

properties.name: The Long Table
properties.known_for: Workers, mechanics, locals, quiet meetings, and relative anonymity
properties.access: Open to the public
properties.description: The Long Table is an old diner and bar just south of the Corporate Core where neighborhood regulars, mechanics, service workers, and people who prefer not to be noticed share booths under old fixtures and repaired ventilation. It survives by being useful, familiar, and uninterested in anyone’s status.
properties.connections: Old City residents, shift workers, mechanics, runners, and lower-level corporate employees

properties.name: Spokane Pump Station 4
properties.status: Aging municipal water and drainage facility
properties.known_for: Old pumps, service tunnels, stormwater infrastructure, and access to legacy utility networks
properties.access: Municipal facility; exterior service areas are visible while operational spaces are restricted
properties.description: Spokane Pump Station 4 is an aging municipal facility near the southern edge of Old City. Its patched pumps, control cabinets, and maintenance shafts connect to older utility, storm, and sewer infrastructure that predates many current street plans.
properties.gm_notes: The old infrastructure should not be treated as proof of treasure, contamination, a replacement underground settlement, or any resolved Adventure 1 mystery.

properties.name: The Exchange
properties.known_for: Flagship offices, restaurants, premium public space, transit connections, and business meetings
properties.access: Public pedestrian space under dense passive surveillance and credential-aware security
properties.organizations: Major corporate tenants and plaza management
properties.description: The Exchange is one of the Corporate Core’s defining public spaces: a broad, meticulously maintained plaza surrounded by flagship offices, restaurants, transit entrances, and expensive civic amenities. It is pleasant, active, and safe precisely because almost everything happening there is observable.
properties.connections: Corporate offices, Mercer Interchange, hotels, restaurants, and executive transit

properties.name: Vesper Row
properties.known_for: Bars, restaurants, clubs, entertainment, visiting professionals, and after-hours corporate social life
properties.access: Public, with venue-specific credentialing and security
properties.description: Vesper Row is the Corporate Core’s principal nightlife corridor, serving corporate workers, clients, travelers, and visitors with polished bars, restaurants, clubs, and late-night entertainment. It is lively rather than lawless, with security designed to be visible only when needed.
properties.connections: Corporate hotels, The Exchange, executive residences, transit, and hospitality networks

properties.name: Mercer Interchange
properties.known_for: Rail, autonomous shuttles, waterfront connections, and passenger-drone transfers
properties.access: Public transit with identity-aware ticketing, screening, and corporate priority services
properties.description: Mercer Interchange combines rail, autonomous vehicles and shuttles, waterfront connections, and passenger-drone infrastructure in a single high-capacity node at the north edge of the Corporate Core.
properties.connections: Corporate Core, Queen Anne, waterfront routes, regional rail, and corporate air mobility

properties.name: West Point Estate
properties.status: Enormous private Queen Anne estate incorporating the old West Point Lighthouse
properties.known_for: One of Seattle’s largest elite compounds and a preserved lighthouse incorporated into private grounds
properties.access: Private estate; public roads nearby remain open
properties.description: West Point Estate is an enormous private compound built around the old West Point Lighthouse. The property belongs to the female CEO of Helion Dynamics and is among the clearest expressions of Queen Anne’s estate culture: landscaped grounds, discreet security, and old civic geography absorbed into private wealth.
properties.gm_notes: Helion Dynamics is distinct from Helios Biotech. Do not conflate the companies or invent a Council/Cabal affiliation for the estate.

properties.name: Discovery Park
properties.status: Elite private arboretum and recreation preserve
properties.known_for: Managed landscapes, arboretum collections, private recreation, clubs, and social events
properties.access: Controlled membership and guest access rather than ordinary public-park access
properties.description: Discovery Park is no longer an ordinary municipal park. It has become an elite arboretum and recreation preserve serving Queen Anne’s wealthy residents through curated landscapes, walking grounds, private recreation, and social events.
properties.connections: Queen Anne estates, private schools, clubs, charities, and West Point

properties.name: Interbay
properties.status: Queen Anne shopping, arts, entertainment, and dining concentration
properties.known_for: Fine dining, galleries, boutiques, performance venues, and elite-oriented commercial life
properties.access: Public streets and businesses with extensive private security
properties.description: Interbay is Queen Anne’s major concentration of shopping, arts, entertainment, and fine dining, where premium retail and cultural venues serve residents and visitors moving between the hill, the waterfront, and marina districts.
properties.connections: Queen Anne residences, waterfront marinas, cultural institutions, restaurants, and corporate visitors

properties.name: Fishermen’s Terminal Yacht-Club Complex
properties.status: Exclusive yacht-club and marina complex replacing the former Fishermen’s Terminal
properties.known_for: Mega-yachts, private berths, marina services, elite social life, and waterfront hospitality
properties.access: Private marina and club access with controlled guest facilities
properties.description: The former Fishermen’s Terminal has been completely replaced by an exclusive yacht-club and marina complex serving Queen Anne’s maritime elite. The Atlas uses this descriptive label because no approved formal club name is established.
properties.connections: Queen Anne yacht culture, Interbay, Salmon Bay, and recurring practical friction with Ballard Reach

properties.name: The Crosscurrent
properties.status: Floating Ballard tavern, marine shop, chandlery, and meeting hall
properties.known_for: Captains’ Council meetings, repairs, supplies, drinks, and maritime gossip
properties.access: Open by water and floating walkways
properties.description: The Crosscurrent is a central floating Ballard establishment combining tavern, marine repair shop, chandlery, and meeting hall. It is the principal meeting place of the informal Captains’ Council. Proprietor Maris Vale, an aquatic/siren metahuman, is a marine mechanic first and bartender second; her Goth daughter Nerissa “Neri” Vale is similarly charismatic while rejecting nearly all of her mother’s social style.
properties.connections: Ballard boat crews, floating communities, repair yards, Captains’ Council, markets, and marine trades

properties.name: The Hardstand
properties.status: Bastion biker, worker, and veteran bar
properties.known_for: Industrial crews, veterans, mechanics, shift changes, job rumors, and informal hiring
properties.access: Public bar in a converted machine shop
properties.description: The Hardstand is a major Everett biker, worker, and veteran bar operating from a converted machine shop. Owner Rhea “Chief” Navarro, a former naval aviation mechanic, keeps the place oriented toward working people rather than corporate hospitality.
properties.connections: Paine aerospace crews, port workers, veterans, private-security staff, and industrial contractors

properties.name: Everett Naval Breakers
properties.status: Industrial salvage and manufacturing complex on the former Naval Station Everett
properties.known_for: Shipbreaking, heavy salvage, contractor work, fabrication, and dismantling an old aircraft carrier
properties.access: Industrial contractor zone with controlled work areas
properties.organizations: Municipal port interests, salvage firms, manufacturers, and defense contractors
properties.description: The former Naval Station Everett now functions as an industrial salvage, manufacturing, and contractor complex. An old aircraft carrier remains under active dismantling, surrounded by cranes, cutting rigs, fabrication sheds, and reused naval infrastructure.
properties.connections: Everett port industry, heavy fabrication, defense contractors, and regional materials markets

properties.name: Paine Industrial Aerodrome
properties.status: Aerospace manufacturing, testing, cargo, and autonomous-systems complex
properties.known_for: Aircraft production, prototypes, drones, cargo, test flights, skilled-labor competition, and corporate espionage opportunities
properties.access: Credentialed industrial and aviation zones around active runways
properties.organizations: AstraVail Technologies, Black Helix Security, aerospace manufacturers, cargo operators, and specialist contractors
properties.description: Paine Field and its surrounding aerospace complex form the Paine Industrial Aerodrome: a dense concentration of aircraft production, prototype testing, autonomous systems, cargo operations, drones, and specialized labor.
properties.gm_notes: AstraVail and Black Helix are peers rather than territorial enemies. Their recurring rivalry centers on skilled workers and contracts; espionage opportunities do not imply an active shooting war.

properties.name: North Bend
properties.status: Ordinary small town at the dependable edge of the Cascade Approaches
properties.known_for: Food, fuel, lodging, repairs, supplies, local information, and access to guides
properties.access: Road access from the metropolitan corridor; routes become substantially less dependable farther east
properties.governance: Ordinary local civic government and community institutions
properties.description: North Bend remains an ordinary small town. Its importance comes from being one of the last familiar service towns before infrastructure becomes substantially less dependable, making it a natural stop for food, fuel, lodging, repairs, supplies, local information, contacts, and guides.
properties.connections: Seattle and Eastside travelers, Cascade routes, local residents, guides, repair shops, and supply networks
